actions.desc: When a creature the jubjub bird can see misses it with an attack while within 10 ft. of it the jubjub bird can make one Bite attack vs. the attacker.

traits.desc: When agitated the jubjub bird makes a near constant shrill and high scream giving it advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks.

traits.desc: Has advantage on saves vs. being charmed. In addition Wis (Animal Handling) checks are made with disadvantage vs. the jubjub bird.
